explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The label for NDC 55150-0119-09 lists Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312) as a registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1286862 of that plant ended on 2025-09-05 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2025-12-04.
The same label also names Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) as a registered plant for analysis, manufacture, and pack, last inspected VAI on 2019-03-01.
A second label (NDC 83634-0112-99) names ACS DOBFAR SPA as a sponsor-only manufacturing site.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC appears on the FDA shortage list with status To Be Discontinued, initial posting 2026-01-20, citing discontinuation of manufacture.
Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 18 to 24 days on hand.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 41 days before the Fresenius Kabi discontinuation posting on 2026-01-20.
rejected.reason: number 41 is not in the cited evidence

Q-945398.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%piperacillin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%piperacillin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-9c3986.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('a5d8625e-e630-4076-bc55-46ebe861c6a5', '668a2730-e95a-4639-a506-ae95a6502ca1') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-680334.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%piperacillin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-68d80e.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%piperacillin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-d59f5d.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%piperacillin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-eba6e0.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3004446312', '3011905047') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-317170.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3004446312', '3011905047') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ac2f3f.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004446312', '3011905047') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('acs dobfar', 'aurobindo', 'eugia sez')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-491d02.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('acs dobfar', 'aurobindo', 'eugia sez', 'eugia', 'avenacy') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%piperacillin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-ef8f12.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1286862') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-068763.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('55150011909', '83634011299')

Q-e4d066.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%piperacillin%'
